title: Source register referenced in the brief is not in the repository
detail: The brief cites S01, S07, S24, FLG-003, SG-27 to SG-30 and a 'careful source register'. None of these files or IDs exist in the repo (it contained only README.md). IDs S01, S07 and S24 cannot be mapped to sources, so this site does not cite them. FLG-003 is used here only for the short-link question the brief describes.
action: Provide the source register file, or confirm that the sources in this site (src/data/sources.json) replace it.

title: Supplied codes are not 10-character ASINs
detail: All five supplied codes (B04G1MEwY, B02NbDxp3, B00hJ57DV, B0c8moW59, B0f3GKalj) are 9 characters. Amazon product URLs observed in this review use 10-character ASINs (e.g., /dp/B0CDY277D3). Therefore no supplied code can be recorded as an intended ASIN. The intended_asin field is left blank.
action: Submitter to confirm the intended ASIN (or the intended product) for each short link.

title: Short-link compliance status unresolved; no Special Link validation performed
detail: The Operating Agreement states that links must use the special 'tagged' link formats Amazon provides ('Special Links'). Our review found that none of the four observed product redirect URLs contains tag=shopnow047c-20. Special Link validation requires logging into the enrolled Associates account, which was not possible in this session. The supplied short links are kept as outbound links, unchanged, and marked sponsored. We do NOT state that the supplied short links are invalid; their compliance status is unresolved.
action: Owner: in the Associates account, test one link per product (destination and tracking report) before replacing any outbound link.

title: Observed redirect ASIN is not derivable from the supplied code
detail: For P01, P02, P04 and P05 the short link redirected to an Amazon listing whose 10-character ASIN differs from the 9-character supplied code. The observed ASIN is recorded in its own field (observed_redirect_asin) and is not merged with the supplied code or the intended ASIN.
action: Submitter to confirm that the observed listing is the intended product.

title: P03 short link did not reach a product page
detail: link.amazon/B00hJ57DV redirected to an Amazon checkpoint page ('To continue, please click the Continue shopping button') on two attempts. No ASIN, title or price was observed. P03 is listed as Not classified and no product data is recorded for it.
action: Submitter to supply the intended product, or re-test the link from the Associates account.

title: Prices, ratings and availability not confirmed
detail: The extracted text of the four product pages did not contain a verifiable price, rating or availability for the listed product (only prices and ratings of other products in 'customers also viewed' carousels were present). These fields are left blank, per the verification rule.
action: Re-check the listing manually and record price, rating and availability with the date. Do not infer from carousels.

title: Click counter and analytics endpoint not built; the five events are not defined in the repo
detail: The brief asks for a privacy-preserving outbound-click counter, a self-hosted analytics endpoint and five defined events. This site is static (GitHub Pages) and cannot run a self-hosted endpoint. The five event definitions are not in the repo. Nothing is tracked.
action: Decide hosting for an endpoint (see SUG-03) and provide the five event definitions.

title: Associates Program Policies only partially reviewed
detail: Only chunk 0 of 11 of the Program Policies page was reviewed. Rules on link formats, link shorteners, content and price display are not yet verified against that page.
action: Manual review of all 11 chunks of the Program Policies before scaling links.

title: Commission rates and the Tracking ID are not verified
detail: No commission rate was confirmed from the Commission Income Statement. The Tracking ID shopnow047c-20 was supplied in the brief and has not been checked against an Associates account. No commission values are shown on the site.
action: Owner to confirm the Tracking ID in the Associates account, and review the Commission Income Statement.

title: Repository was empty at the start of this work
detail: At commit 847ae37 the repository contained only README.md ('# Affil3'). There was no COORDINATION.md, no data, no site and no existing product table. All data in this site was created in this session from the five supplied links.

title: Editorial hypotheses are not validated
detail: The four question-shaped guide titles were supplied as working hypotheses. They are not supported by search volume, traffic or conversion data. No such data is available in the repo or from the sources reviewed.
action: Measure demand (search and click data) before writing full guides. See SUG-04.

title: Product-level claims from listing titles are seller claims
detail: Features such as '26QT', '10-in-1', 'Dishwasher-Safe' and 'Dual Basket' are text from the seller's listing title. They are recorded as 'as stated in title' and have not been tested or independently verified.
action: Verify each specification against the product information table before using it in a guide.

title: ASIN format (10 characters) not confirmed on an official Amazon help page
detail: The 10-character format is confirmed by the URLs of official Amazon product pages in this register. The Seller Central ASIN help page was seen only in search results and third-party guides also state the format. Manual check is recommended.
action: Open the Seller Central ASIN help page and record the format statement.

title: Owner input needed for the Associates test and intended ASINs
detail: Three items cannot be completed from this session alone: the Associates Special Link test (FLG-003), intended ASIN confirmation (FLG-002) and the Tracking ID check (FLG-009). The brief asked for no manual input. These items are published as open questions and do not block the site from being published.
action: See the Questions page (Q-01 to Q-04).
